text:
Maya P: FYI — Aperture.ai just confirmed they want their open 7B model listed via our Marketplace and also want a joint blog + co-demo with an SI. Need to lock terms: hosting rights, redistribution, and announcement cadence. ETA for contracts?
Alex L: Thanks. Do they want weights downloadable, or hosted-only? That drives licensing language and export checks.
Maya P: They explicitly asked for hosted API + dedicated listing (download is negotiable but they'd prefer hosted-only initially). They mentioned possible edge bundles with our HW partners later.
Sanjay R: Hosted-only simplifies infra & export, but SI co-demo might need a dockerized runtime for on-prem proof-of-concept. Can we offer an eval artifact (non-downloadable) to partners?
Alex L: We can do a controlled POC package under a non-distribution addendum. Key points: no public redistribution of weights, hosted serving allowed, SI may run POC under NDA + limited-term license. Need export clause for restricted countries + KYC for SI.
Noah K: Tech note — if we allow an SI POC we'll ship a container image that calls our inference endpoint (no weights inside). That fits hosted-only. For on-prem demos we can also provide an inference shim but still proxy through customer-owned infra to avoid shipping weights.
Ellie M: Timing question — marketing wants a joint announcement in April. Legal/partnerships need final sign-off by end of March to make that. Is that feasible?
Alex L: End of March deadline ok if Aperture signs their addendum by next week. I'll draft: hosted-listing clause, non-distribution addendum, SI POC license, export/KYC paragraph.
Maya P: @Alex L can you include a short permissive dev-use clause for research groups at colleges (non-commercial), or is that messy? Aperture asked for academic exceptions.
Alex L: We can include a carve-out: "academic research use permitted with attribution; still no redistribution or commercial hosting." Will need Aperture buy-in.
legal-bot: Reminder: include export control template block from 2025-ipo-clauses v2.
Noah K: For Marketplace SKU, suggest two SKUs: "Hosted (Public API)" and "Hosted + SI POC (NDA)". Pricing & rate limits to be set by Partnerships. Also tag for HW partners if they want to bundle the dedicated inference offer.
Sanjay R: Agree on SKUs. For HW bundles, add compatibility note (quantization profile supported, min GPU memory) so SI/HW folks know constraints.
Ellie M: For announcements: proposed timeline — Week 1: legal finalize; Week 2: joint PR draft + customer-ready demo; Week 3: marketing assets and SI rehearsal; Week 4: publish. Can we compress?
Maya P: I'll coordinate Aperture + SI calendar. Goal: announce April 15. If legal doesn't finish by Mar 31, move to May 6.
Alex L: I'll post a first draft of contract language by EOD Fri. Will include code-ish snippet for the non-distribution clause: 
```
No Distribution: Licensee shall not redistribute, resell, or otherwise make the Model Weights available to third parties. Permitted: hosted inference via Redwood API and limited-term on-prem POC under NDA.
```
Maya P: Nice. Also need a short marketplace blurb (100–150 words) and 2 screenshots from the SI demo. Ellie you want to own that?
Ellie M: Yep, I'll draft the blurb after Alex posts contract draft. Noah — can you export 2 lightweight screenshots (no weights) from the demo harness?
Noah K: Yup, will grab screenshots and a short gif. Will anonymize logs.
Alex L: Quick flag — check data-processing language: who owns telemetry from demo sessions? Propose telemetry stays with Redwood unless Aperture opts in to shared telemetry for model quality metrics.
Maya P: Good call. Put telemetry opt-in into the addendum.
Ellie M: I'll prepare the PR outline and a co-approval workflow (Aperture -> Redwood -> SI) so approvals don't get stuck.
Sanjay R: Ops note — enable a canary route for new model traffic, plus auto-fallback to a baseline model for SLA continuity. Ops wants a week to validate.
Maya P: Action items: Alex drafts addendum by EOD Fri; Noah prepares demo assets by Tue; Ellie drafts blurb + PR outline by Tue; Maya coordinates Aperture + SI sign-off.
Alex L: ACK.
Noah K: ACK.
Ellie M: ACK.
Maya P: Thanks team — I'll push calendar invites. :rocket:
